Account & Data Deletion Request

Under Google Play Policy and user privacy standards, residents and users of the NexGate Resident Application can request permanent deletion of their account and all associated personal data directly from this web page.

🛡️
No App Re-installation Required: If you have already uninstalled the NexGate app or no longer have device access, submitting this form will process the permanent deletion of your account and unbind your flat unit.

What data is permanently deleted upon this request?

  • ✕ User Account: Name, 10-digit mobile number, email, and authentication tokens.
  • ✕ Flat Association: Your ownership/tenant binding with your society flat will be unlinked and set to vacant.
  • ✕ Visitor Logs & Gate Passes: Historical visitor requests, photos, delivery passes, and entry logs.
  • ✕ Household Records: Registered family members and registered vehicle records.
  • ✕ Device Push Tokens: FCM push notification registration keys and session data.
